In the November 2 visit thread, Ron says he will arrange someone to meet Scott for an afternoon punch walk. He does not name that person, set an exact walkthrough time, or say he will personally attend.

These messages do not revise Ron's earlier Wednesday October 28 EOD target for Tyson's remaining work and do not establish completed work, punch-list acceptance, inspection approval, or CO. November 2 walkthrough planning is separate from the October 28 completion statement.

No newer Alex or City response located. Alex's latest update remains one installation item expected this week with no firm completion/inspection date. No reply found to the owner's sent request for interim inspection/store setup. The City-confirmed dependency remains landlord permit B2609-071 final approval before TI permit B2512-031 final approval. No passed stair-inspection report or issued CO found.
